title: Witch's Midnight Potion
description: A hooded witch with three eyes pours a glowing blue potion from a bottle into a small glowing house-shaped lantern on a wooden table. She is surrounded by floating tarot cards, a decorated blue dog, a gothic cathedral, and a heart-shaped tree dripping colorful liquid against a starry night sky.
prompt: A three-eyed hooded witch wearing a black robe pours a glowing blue and red potion into a small illuminated house lantern on a wooden table. Floating tarot cards, a decorated blue dog sitting nearby, a massive gothic cathedral with purple windows in the background, a heart-shaped tree made of purple vines dripping red green and purple liquid, starry night sky with constellations, intricate line art with vibrant colors, dark fantasy style
